data.mechanism: The LKB1-AMPK axis keeps damaged mitochondria being cleared; lose it and mitochondrial DNA leaks into the cytosol and inflames the cell.
data.mechanism_beginner: The energy-sensing pathway keeps damaged mitochondria cleared out; lose it, and their broken contents leak out and inflame the cell.
data.boundary: Single-study edge in this corpus (ZHU2026), and that study is a toxicology model rather than a dedicated test of this step. Treat as indicative.
